text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
............
...What are your thoughts on the Ship of Theseus?

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text: "What if, at the end of my research, there lies a discovery that reshapes everything...?"

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
That structure... beyond the transformation,
just how far does being an Umamusume go...?

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
...That question...
is just spinning round and round in my head right now...

Is it because of the consecutive races?
For the sake of the future, we should
probably review the schedule.
